content_text: [1/2 @muratcan] Jokes aside, it’s time to move away from this style of prompting. For anything that actually runs long hours, multiple context windows, parallel workers, or loops, you need long-horizon-prompting instead. The new style uses a pseudo-formal task brief: - Defines exactly what “done” looks like with clear, measurable success conditions - Explicitly lists what doesn’t count as a win (stops agents from gaming the result) - Adds an independent fresh-context reviewer that double-checks everything - Forces the agent to explore different approaches instead of endlessly tweaking the same idea - Sets strict rules for when to stop and what to actually deliver I just released the full prompting skill with references here: https://github.com/muratcankoylan/Agent-Skills-for-Context-Engineering/tree/main/skills/long-horizon-prompting --- [2/2 @muratcan] Use it wisely ☠️
